content.json:
## RequestHub release records
Every release job prints one record per step (`RELEASE-RECORD`), which Log Analytics keeps. A *release* deploys a build as a candidate with no traffic and gates it; a person decides with *promote* (go) or *abort* (no-go); *rollback* moves traffic back; *drill* rehearses a bad release. Records reach Log Analytics a minute or two after a step finishes.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "release" and ContainerGroupName_s startswith "caj-" and Log_s startswith "RELEASE-RECORD "
| extend r = parse_json(substring(Log_s, 15))
| extend Started = format_datetime(todatetime(r.startedAt), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), Job = tostring(r.step), Step = tostring(r.command), Result = tostring(r.status), Seconds = todouble(r.seconds), Outcome = tostring(r.outcome), Execution = tostring(r.execution)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Execution, Step, tostring(r.startedAt)
| project Started, Job, Step, Result, Seconds, Outcome, Execution
| order by Started desc
content.title: Release steps: select a row to see its checks

content.query:
let records = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "release" and ContainerGroupName_s startswith "caj-" and Log_s startswith "RELEASE-RECORD "
| extend r = parse_json(substring(Log_s, 15));
let selected = "{Execution}";
let pick = iff(isempty(selected) or selected == "latest", toscalar(records | top 1 by TimeGenerated desc | project tostring(r.execution)), selected);
records
| where tostring(r.execution) == pick
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(r.command), tostring(r.startedAt)
| mv-expand c = r.checks
| where isnotempty(c)
| project Started = format_datetime(todatetime(r.startedAt), "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"), Step = tostring(r.command), Target = tostring(c['where']), Check = tostring(c.name), Result = iff(tobool(c.ok), "pass", "FAIL"), Detail = tostring(c.detail)
| order by Started asc
content.title: Checks of the selected step's job execution (the latest when nothing is selected)

content.query:
let records = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "release" and ContainerGroupName_s startswith "caj-" and Log_s startswith "RELEASE-RECORD "
| extend r = parse_json(substring(Log_s, 15))
| where array_length(r.evidence) > 0;
let selected = "{Execution}";
let pick = iff(isempty(selected) or selected == "latest", toscalar(records | top 1 by TimeGenerated desc | project tostring(r.execution)), selected);
records
| where tostring(r.execution) == pick
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(r.startedAt)
| mv-expand e = r.evidence
| project Candidate = tostring(r.candidate.revision), Evidence = tostring(e)
content.title: Why the candidate failed: what the gate read from its live logs before removing it
content.noDataMessage: No failed gate in this time range, or for the selected step.

content.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.app/containerapps' and name =~ '__API_APP__' and resourceGroup =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP__'
| mv-expand t = properties.configuration.ingress.traffic
| project Revision = tostring(split(tostring(t.revisionName), '--')[1]), Label = tostring(t.label), Traffic = toint(t.weight)
| order by Traffic desc, Label asc
content.title: Traffic now (Azure Resource Graph)

content.query:
resourcechanges
| where tostring(properties.targetResourceId) endswith '/containerApps/__API_APP__'
| extend At = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp), Changes = properties.changes
| where tostring(Changes) has 'ingress.traffic'
| mv-expand bagexpansion = array Change = Changes
| extend Property = tostring(Change[0]), Before = tostring(Change[1].previousValue), After = tostring(Change[1].newValue)
| where Property has 'ingress.traffic' and (Property endswith '.weight' or Property endswith '.label' or Property endswith '.revisionName')
| extend Before = iff(Property endswith '.revisionName', tostring(split(Before, '--')[1]), Before), After = iff(Property endswith '.revisionName', tostring(split(After, '--')[1]), After)
| project At, Property = replace_string(Property, 'properties.configuration.ingress.', ''), Before, After
| order by At desc, Property asc
content.title: Traffic changes (Resource Graph change history)
